gens: As a family member, I want to receive notifications about upcoming shifts, so that I can plan my schedule.
As a cinema manager, I want to view the showtimes for each showtime, so that I can manage staff effectively.
As a clinic manager, I want to generate monthly reports on clinic performance, so that I can optimize staffing.
As a citizen, I want to request a digital signature for my documents, so that I can manage my workload.
As a stylist, I want to see my rental history, so that I can track my performance.
